test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 03 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If X – Y means that X is the mother of Y, X × Y means that X is the father of Y, X ÷ Y means that X is the sister of Y, then which of the following expression shows that Q is the son of P?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31358178cf2a5957036a81f6b961d04d7d751d199f015e1e44702b963704c4a5.png] 

Given: 

‘X - Y’ means ‘X is the Mother of Y’.

‘X × Y’ means ‘X is the Father of Y’.

‘X ÷ Y’ means ‘X is the Sister of Y’.

 
 

 Symbol
 Symbol denoted Relation
 
 

 -
 Mother
 
 

 × 
 Father
 
 

 ÷ 
 Sister
 
 

 

Find:- expression shows that Q is the son of P?

Let's check each option one by one.

**Option 1) **P – Q ÷ R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61d2b0e8f1e23c7d00c30829c8673e74f2542fa39e35772f56ea1e97addbfcd3.png] 

Here, Q is the Daughter of P. (Incorrect)

**Option 2) **P – Q × R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/303335fd00fc6eeabd151b52037a4077a3739c2daef77b52598d2d73b9ff39cd.png] 

Here, Q is the Son of P. (Correct)

**Option 3) **Q – P × R

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/67607639973e6f1901f1fa2abab52c152af0a70b3e3231fabf5f9dd3d197f3b8.png] 

Here, Q is the mother of P. (Incorrect)

**Option 4) **R × Q – P

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f679a09db47fa09182cc6d062c58335b2615ac49304bc9212a217f7f883a0cad.png] 

Here, Q is the mother of P. (Incorrect)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
